map.由总数与各类别数求多项式系数 使用指南: Multinomial coefficient from total and category counts guide
map.输入总数 n 与三个类别数 k₁、k₂、k₃（和为 n），求多项式系数。: Enter total n and the three category counts k1, k2, k3 (summing to n) to get the multinomial coefficient.
map.多项式系数 C(n; k₁,k₂,…,k_m) 出现在多项式展开 (x₁+…+x: The multinomial coefficient C(n; k1, k2, ..., k_m) appears as coefficients in the expansion (x1+...+x_m)^n.
map.也用于把 n 个可区分对象分成指定大小的若干组（分配/分组计数）。: Also used to split n distinguishable objects into several groups of specified size (allocation/grouping counts).
map.约束 k₁+k₂+…+k_m = n，否则无意义。: Constraint k1 + k2 + ... + k_m = n, otherwise it is meaningless.

map.多项式系数和二项式系数什么关系？: How does the multinomial coefficient relate to the binomial coefficient?
map.二项式系数是 m=2 的特例：C(n;k,n−k) = n!/(k!(n−k)!: The binomial coefficient is the special case m=2: C(n; k, n-k) = n!/(k!(n-k)!) = C(n,k). The multinomial coefficient generalizes it to multi-class grouping.
map.什么时候用多项式系数？: When is the multinomial coefficient used?
map.当展开式含多于两项（如 (a+b+c)ⁿ）或要把 n 个对象按既定规模分到多个组: Use it when the expansion has more than two terms (such as (a+b+c)^n) or when n objects must be split into several groups of fixed size. Order within a group is ignored and group sizes are fixed, which are its defining features.
